question: Rebuild the SQD transfer graph of October 2026 on Arbitrum and Base with the exchange, contract, bridge and P2P data, so it shows new information rather than the same graph

definitions.entity: A node of the graph. All the labelled addresses and inferred deposit addresses of one exchange are one entity, named for the exchange. A mint or burn makes the chain's bridge to Ethereum an entity. Every other address is its own entity
definitions.edge: SQD that went from one entity to another in the window, per chain and category. Moves between an exchange's own addresses are left out. A paired Arbitrum-to-Base bridge flow is an edge across chains
definitions.group: The kind of an entity for the flow matrix - exchange, contract, eoa or bridge
definitions.cross-exchange wallet: An address that is no exchange, got SQD from one exchange and sent SQD to a different exchange in the window, directly or through that exchange's deposit addresses

alternatives: Keep each exchange address as its own node
Count a wallet that gets SQD from an exchange and sends it back to the same exchange as cross-exchange
The other readings listed in answers/sqd-categories/question.yaml

-- How many addresses that are no exchange took SQD out of one exchange and paid SQD into a different one
-- in October 2026, on Arbitrum or Base. sqd_flow_map_cross_exchange lists them.
with classified as (
    
with transfers as (
    select chain, id, block_number, block_timestamp, tx_hash, from_address, to_address, value
    from "warehouse"."analytics_sqd"."erc20_transfers"
    where chain = 'arbitrum'
        and token = '0x1337420ded5adb9980cfc35f8f2b054ea86f8ab1'
        and block_number between 510496864 and 520129273
        and from_address <> to_address
    union all
    select chain, id, block_number, block_timestamp, tx_hash, from_address, to_address, value
    from "warehouse"."analytics_sqd"."erc20_transfers"
    where chain = 'base'
        and token = '0xd4554bea546efa83c1e6b389ecac40ea999b3e78'
        and block_number between 52011727 and 53350926
        and from_address <> to_address
),

labels as (
    select chain, address, kind, exchange from "warehouse"."analytics_sqd"."address_labels"
),

-- Addresses whose every transfer out in the window went to one exchange's labelled addresses.
deposits as (
    select t.chain, t.from_address as address, min(l.exchange) as exchange
    from transfers as t
    left join labels as l on l.chain = t.chain and l.address = t.to_address and l.kind = 'exchange'
    left join labels as self on self.chain = t.chain and self.address = t.from_address
    where t.from_address <> '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'
        and coalesce(self.kind, '') <> 'exchange'
    group by t.chain, t.from_address
    having bool_and(l.exchange is not null) and count(distinct l.exchange) = 1
),

sides as (
    select
        t.*,
        case
            when t.from_address = '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' then 'bridge'
            when fd.address is not null then 'deposit'
            else coalesce(fl.kind, 'unknown')
        end as from_kind,
        coalesce(fl.exchange, fd.exchange) as from_exchange,
        case
            when t.to_address = '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' then 'bridge'
            when td.address is not null then 'deposit'
            else coalesce(tl.kind, 'unknown')
        end as to_kind,
        coalesce(tl.exchange, td.exchange) as to_exchange
    from transfers as t
    left join labels as fl on fl.chain = t.chain and fl.address = t.from_address
    left join labels as tl on tl.chain = t.chain and tl.address = t.to_address
    left join deposits as fd on fd.chain = t.chain and fd.address = t.from_address
    left join deposits as td on td.chain = t.chain and td.address = t.to_address
)

select
    *,
    case
        when 'bridge' in (from_kind, to_kind) then 'bridge'
        when from_kind in ('exchange', 'deposit') or to_kind in ('exchange', 'deposit') then 'exchange'
        when 'contract' in (from_kind, to_kind) then 'contract'
        when from_kind = 'eoa' and to_kind = 'eoa' then 'p2p'
        else 'unknown'
    end as category
from sides
),

-- Each transfer between entities: an exchange's addresses and deposit addresses are the exchange, a mint
-- or burn's zero address is the chain's bridge, any other address is itself.
sides as (
    select
        chain,
        category,
        value,
        case
            when from_kind in ('exchange', 'deposit') then from_exchange
            when from_kind = 'bridge' then 'bridge:' || chain
            else from_address
        end as source,
        case when from_kind = 'deposit' then 'exchange' else from_kind end as source_group,
        case
            when to_kind in ('exchange', 'deposit') then to_exchange
            when to_kind = 'bridge' then 'bridge:' || chain
            else to_address
        end as target,
        case when to_kind = 'deposit' then 'exchange' else to_kind end as target_group
    from classified
),

taken as (
    select distinct target as wallet, source as exchange
    from sides
    where source_group = 'exchange' and target_group <> 'exchange'
),

paid as (
    select distinct source as wallet, target as exchange
    from sides
    where target_group = 'exchange' and source_group <> 'exchange'
)

select count(distinct t.wallet) as cross_exchange_wallets
from taken as t
join paid as p on p.wallet = t.wallet and p.exchange <> t.exchange

same_chain as (
    select source, source_group, target, target_group, chain, category, sum(value) as value, count(*) as transfers
    from sides
    where source <> target
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
),

cross_chain as (
    select
        p.from_address as source,
        coalesce(f.kind, 'unknown') as source_group,
        p.to_address as target,
        coalesce(t.kind, 'unknown') as target_group,
        p.from_chain || '>' || p.to_chain as chain,
        'bridge' as category,
        sum(p.amount) as value,
        count(*) as transfers
    from "warehouse"."analytics_sqd"."bridge_pairs" as p
    left join "warehouse"."analytics_sqd"."address_labels" as f on f.chain = p.from_chain and f.address = p.from_address
    left join "warehouse"."analytics_sqd"."address_labels" as t on t.chain = p.to_chain and t.address = p.to_address
    where p.ethereum_token = '0x1337420ded5adb9980cfc35f8f2b054ea86f8ab1'
        and p.withdrawn_at >= '2026-10-01 00:00:00+00' and p.withdrawn_at < '2026-11-01 00:00:00+00'
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
)

select source, source_group, target, target_group, chain, category, round(value / 1e18, 6) as sqd, transfers
from (
    select * from same_chain
    union all
    select * from cross_chain
) as edges
order by value desc, source, target, chain
